plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Atom library — 19 project-agnostic skills: report (给 CEO 的收尾汇报), write-plan (可验收计划立项, 原 advanced-plan), grill-me (开工前决策盘问, CEO/CTO 分层), debrief (收盘 sedimentation), dispatch-vendors (整块独立任务派给 vendor CLI), blindspot (unknown-unknowns territory briefing), worktree, handoff (全局 ~/tmp 交接), exa-code, create-readable-html (可读 HTML 交付物, 原 html-doc), agent-reach (YouTube 字幕等平台触达封装), media-understanding (音视频 → Gemini 转写理解), docs-organize (文档—事实—代码锚点体检), audit-context, skill-atlas, skill-forge (技能铸造, 消化自 yao-meta-skill, vendored 评测工具链), cto-audit (慢循环退火审计), ccobs, recall (ccobs 观测账本先例召回). 3 subagents: general-skills-executor, advisor, code-search. 3 PreToolUse hooks: skill-guard、worktree-guard、skill-atlas-guard. ship SOP 已迁居 kox-agent-plugins（编排层贴项目基建）.
